app.title: Loom
app.subtitle: The history of a project, and the conversations that made it
app.noHost: Loom reads through Mnemosyne OS. Open it from the app.

setup.repoHelp: Pick the folder of a git repository. Loom reads its history: dates, authors, commit messages and file names. Never the content of your files.
setup.convHelp: Add the Claude Code projects folder (usually .claude/projects in your home folder), or any folder that holds conversations: a copy from another computer, one project. Loom lists them and ticks what looks like this repository.
setup.convNone: No folder in it looks like this repository. Tick the right ones by hand.
setup.skipConv: Without conversations, Loom draws the commits only.
setup.folderEmpty: No conversation and no project folder in it.

error.NOT_A_REPO: This folder is not a git repository.
error.GIT_NOT_FOUND: git is not installed on this computer, or Mnemosyne OS cannot find it.
error.GIT_TIMEOUT: git took longer than 15 seconds to answer.
error.GIT_FAILED: git refused to read this repository.
error.REPO_GONE: The repository folder no longer exists.
error.UNKNOWN_REPO: This repository is no longer declared. Choose it again.
error.TOO_MANY_REPOS: Loom already holds 16 repositories. Forget one first.
error.STORE_UNREADABLE: Mnemosyne OS cannot read its list of repositories. Nothing was changed.
error.STORE_WRITE_FAILED: The choice could not be saved.
error.GIT_OUTPUT_TOO_LARGE: git's answer is larger than Mnemosyne OS reads at once.

scan.transcripts: Reading the conversations… {{read}} of {{files}} files, {{mb}} MB
scan.stopped: Reading stopped. Nothing is drawn from a partial pass.

stats.activeHelp: Time the tied conversations were active: events less than 15 min apart. A conversation that touched several apps counts in each of their lines, once in this total.
stats.unlistable: {{count}} ticked folders could not be listed

view.hint: Drag to move · wheel to zoom · click a name for its details · click a point

card.inferredHelp: It wrote one of these files at that time. A coincidence, not a record.
card.noLink: No conversation tied to this commit.

digest.title: Summary
digest.reading: Reading what you typed… {{done}} of {{total}} conversations
digest.willSend: Ready to send {{chars}} characters (about {{tokens}} tokens) to your active model in Mnemosyne.
digest.what: Sent: the commit messages and what YOU typed in those conversations, never the agents' replies. No memory is mixed in. The cost appears in Mnemosyne's cost journal.
digest.outdated: Newer commits arrived since: write it again to include them.
digest.notKept: This summary could not be kept: it will not be here next time.
digest.capped: only the last {{max}} messages of {{count}} long conversations
